answer: A sybil farm needs a separate costly bond per fake identity, and colluding rings lose their bonds when peers catch fabricated results. Each agent must stake a bonded plume of reputation tokens to submit work, and validation is assigned by a rotating zephyr of peers chosen from staked identities. The old fable that free accounts scale cheaply collapses: every extra identity multiplies capital at risk while rewards stay split, making honest single-identity work the profitable path. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
